_note: Starting weights for points = severity x urgency x difficulty x rarity. Tuned so most bounties land between 150 and 350 points, with confirmed-exploited ones much higher. Change freely.

severity._note: base + per_impact_point x CVSS 3 impact (0-6). Granite's estimate is used when NIST has no score.

difficulty._note: fix_type weights apply to Granite's answer; fix_type_missing is used for CVEs Granite has not labelled yet.
